contact.name: Arlette Falzon Seychell
contact.evidence_quote: Our pharmacy business was established back in 2006 by a pharmacist, Arlette Falzon Seychell, together with her husband, Owen Falzon. San Filippu Pharmacy in Senglea was the first of the group. Today the pharmacy in Senglea, renamed Milia’s Pharmacy, has moved to new, bigger and modern premises which reflect more the strategy, culture and values of our pharmacy group.
